extension.description: Recursively sorts XML files by tags and attributes while preserving comments and formatting.
command.sortActiveEditor.title: Smart XML Sorter: Sort XML
config.indent.description: Indentation depth in spaces for the sorted XML.
config.sortKeys.description: Comma-separated priority list of attributes used to distinguish identical XML tags.
config.pythonPath.description: Optional path to the Python interpreter (e.g., /usr/bin/python3 or C:\Python\python.exe). When empty, Python is automatically searched in the system PATH.
